title: Analyze/fix  platform_tests/test_platform_info.py failures
author: yejianquan
body: Test failure seen on backend T0

comments.author: yejianquan
comments.body:
Related to  https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8944
test case will try to traverse syslog to see whether all things go well, but it found the error log "ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_QUEUE" which is not supposed to appear, so it failed

linkedPullRequests.title: [platform_test]add ignored syslog regular expression

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Backend T0 topo platform test cases failed because of the noisy error logs.
Need to add the noisy error logs to the ignored error log list.
#### How did you do it?
Add noisy error log to the ignored error log list.
#### How did you verify/test it?
Since the error can't be reproduced, I simply test the regular expression on my local machine to make sure it matches the noisy error log.
